name: Terry Hanton
bio:

The company listed on the London stock Exchange, in 1994, the first Caribbean company to do so. I left in 1996 and then  developed Sugar Hill for David Lloyd and a syndicate of investors.  Spent the last 5 years helping Paul Altman develop Lime Grove.
PCS, of which i am MD and owner, is a multi disciplinary property Consulting and advisory firm with Caribbean reach.   Our main lines of business are property appraisal, accountancy services, feasibility and market studies and property advisory services.
